Adam Woodyattian Beale Celebrity Face Mask

Each Adam Woodyattian Beale face mask is digitally printed in full colour on 350gsm silk card, cut to shape around the face, with pre-cut eye holes, plus elastic and sticky tabs so it takes seconds to put together. Can't find the face you need? We also make custom masks from your own photo.

  • Full-colour digital print for a sharp, recognisable face
  • Posted flat in a board-backed envelope to keep it crease-free
  • Full A4 size (297 x 210 mm), so it covers an adult face
  • An easy, cheap way to theme an Oscars-style party
  • Brilliant for photo booths and group shots

Size & details

  • Size: 297 x 210 mm (A4), a full adult-size face
  • Material: 350gsm silk card, full-colour digital print
  • Finish: semi-waterproof
  • Fit: one size for adults; elastic and sticky tabs included
  • Pre-cut eye holes; cut to the shape of the face
  • Packaging: board-backed envelope

Delivery

Printed in our UK workshop and posted to you. Dispatch and postage options are shown at checkout.

Olivia Wilde Fancy Dress Face Mask

We print this film star mask in full colour on thick 350gsm silk card, cut it to the shape of the face and pre-cut the eye holes. Elastic and sticky tabs are included. Can't find the face you need? We also make custom masks from your own photo.

Why you'll love it

  • Thick 350gsm silk card holds its shape all night
  • Semi-waterproof finish, so it copes with spilt drinks and outdoor parties
  • Pre-cut eye holes, with elastic and sticky tabs included
  • Full-colour digital print for a sharp, recognisable face
  • Posted flat in a board-backed envelope to keep it crease-free

Size & details

  • Size: 297 x 210 mm (A4), a full adult-size face
  • Material: 350gsm silk card, full-colour digital print
  • Finish: semi-waterproof
  • Fit: one size for adults; elastic and sticky tabs included
  • Pre-cut eye holes; cut to the shape of the face
  • Packaging: board-backed envelope

Delivery

Printed in our UK workshop and posted to you. Dispatch and postage options are shown at checkout.

  • Thick 350gsm silk card holds its shape all night

Size & details

  • Size: 297 x 210 mm (A4), a full adult-size face
  • Material: 350gsm silk card, full-colour digital print
  • Finish: semi-waterproof
  • Fit: one size for adults; elastic and sticky tabs included
  • Pre-cut eye holes; cut to the shape of the face
  • Packaging: board-backed envelope

Delivery

Printed in our UK workshop and posted to you. Dispatch and postage options are shown at checkout.
